title: Canonical derived base-change morphism
statement: Let f:X\to S and g:S'\to S be morphisms of schemes, let X'=X\times_S S' with projections f':X'\to S' and g':X'\to X, so that X'\xrightarrow{g'}X over S'\xrightarrow{g}S is a cartesian square with f\circ g'=g\circ f' [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. For E in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], the canonical derived base-change morphism Lg^*Rf_*E\to Rf'_*Lg'^*E is the adjoint under Lg^*\dashv Rg_* [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] of the composite Rf_*E\to Rf_*Rg'_*Lg'^*E\cong R(f\circ g')_*Lg'^*E=R(g\circ f')_*Lg'^*E\cong Rg_*Rf'_*Lg'^*E, whose first arrow is Rf_* of the unit E\to Rg'_*Lg'^*E of the adjunction Lg'^*\dashv Rg'_* [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] and whose isomorphisms are the canonical composition isomorphisms for derived direct images [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition]. For an open W\subseteq X with W'=(g')^{-1}(W), the same construction applied to the cartesian square formed by f|_W, f'|_{W'}, g and g'|_{W'} gives the derived base-change morphism Lg^*R(f|_W)_*(E|_W)\to R(f'|_{W'})_*L(g'|_{W'})^*(E|_W).

source.place: Remark 07A7 and Lemma 0736: base-change map as the adjoint of the derived counit/unit construction

proof.text: Use SheafOfModules.tensorClosed for the additive symmetric monoidal closed structure and schemeModule_hasFunctorialFlatResolution for functorial flat resolutions of O_Y-modules.

HomotopyCategory.kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic and kFlat_quotient_obj_iff translate the generic K-flat predicate to the acyclic tensor predicate. Apply tensorPullback_quasiIso_of_isKFlat to obtain the generic PreservesKFlatQuasiIso instance.

The library derives_kFlat theorem and isLeftDerivedFunctor_comp_of_isLeftDerivabilityStructure show that the supplied left-derived counit remains a derived counit after postcomposition. Dually KInjectives.localizerMorphism and isRightDerivedFunctor_comp_of_isRightDerivabilityStructure show the same for the recorded direct-image unit. Both comparisons are isomorphisms on their resolution classes.

Apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derived to the mapped tensor-pullback/direct-image adjunction. Its derived-unit factorization and naturality of the right-derived unit yield the displayed Hom equivalence.

The unchanged schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap transposes the canonical pullback-composition comparison followed by the derived counit, using the pinned adjunction just constructed. The composition comparisons and their supplied left-derived counits come from exists_derivedPullbackComposition.

lean.note: The node has no recorded Lean declaration on the base. This dependency module states its scheme O-module notion. Defines the mate of the pullback composition comparison and derived counit (08HY), equivalently the unit/direct-image-composition construction. The constructor accepts any commutative square, so also applies to the restricted-open square. Second reading uses adjunctions pinned to the same left-derived counits as the composition comparisons and the recorded right-derived units; arbitrary independent adjunction choices have been removed.
